newsitem.title: CHINA: China alkyl benzene plant to open soon - agency.
newsitem.headline: China alkyl benzene plant to open soon - agency.

text.p: A 1.6 billion yuan ($190 million) alkyl benzene plant in northwestern China's Xinjiang region is to go into full operation in the next few days, the China News Service said on Thursday.
The Dushanzi petrochemical plant was expected to produce around 72,000 tonnes of alkyl benzene a year, the agency said but gave no details.
Benzene is used as a solvent and in the manufacture of plastics, insecticides, detergents and other products.

A separate project to boost Dushanzi's production of ethylene to 220,000 tonnes a year from 140,000 tonnes would be completed by 2000, the China News Service quoted the petrochemical base manager Chen Zongyu as saying.
Dushanzi's sales this year could reach more than 5.0 billion yuan, Chen said.
